Uses local Melo Chinese/English INT8, one voice. First download from Hugging Face is about 57.8 MiB including weights, lexicon, text rules and license. Response text stays on device. Tap Read aloud again after installation.

One completed response at a time. Stop and replay as needed. Reading stops on session change, leaving chat, backgrounding, voice input, lost audio focus or disconnected headphones; it never resumes automatically. Streaming responses are excluded.
